details.name: Description
details.value:
Your Story:

You're the person who can't do the same task twice without thinking "there has to be a way to automate this." You use AI tools every day, not just for chatting, but to actually build stuff. You've made your own GPTs, Claude projects, bots, or automations just because you wanted to see if you could. Now you want to do it for real, at a company that's all in on AI. If that sounds like you, keep reading.


﻿Who We Are:

EX.CO is the video technology fueling growth for media leaders worldwide. Since we launched, our mission has been to shape the future of media technology, powering publishers' business success in a rapidly changing reality. Today, we partner with leading media companies, including USA Today, Hearst Newspapers, Motorsport Network, The Arena Group (Parade, The Street), and Ziff Davis (Mashable), to maximize revenue across every screen: web, mobile apps, CTV, and DOOH. Our technology combines an online video platform with a machine learning-based yield engine, giving media owners the control, scale, and transparency they need to thrive.

What drives us is simple: we're stronger together, always evolving, and radically transparent. Collaboration fuels our best work, innovation keeps us ahead, and honesty builds lasting trust with our colleagues, partners, and customers. We are proudly backed by The Walt Disney Company, Saban Ventures, Viola Group, 83North, and others.

Now we're growing our team, and that's where you come in. We're building a place where talented people make an impact, ideas spark change, and everyone has a seat at the table.


﻿What You'll Do:

  • As part of the AdOps team, you’ll learn our day-to-day work from the inside out: the routines, the repetitive tasks, and the pain points. You’ll map these processes, streamline them with AI and automation, and build tools that help the team work faster and smarter.
  • Map our daily workflows (reporting, QA, ticket triage, publisher monitoring) and find what can be automated
  • Build automations and internal tools using AI assistants, Claude skills and agents, n8n/Zapier/Make, and Google Apps Script
  • Create and grow a skill library the whole team can use
  • Document every workflow you build and train the team to use it
  • Own the evaluation and integration of new AI tools, prioritizing those with clear operational value.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
What We're Looking For:

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), with advanced prompting that goes way beyond simple chat
  • A portfolio of things you've built: an automation, a GPT/Gem/Claude project, a script, a bot. Show us!
  • Curious, self-driven, and happy to learn new tools on your own
  • Clear communicator who can explain what you built to people who aren't technical


﻿Advantage:

  • Hands-on experience in AdOps or ad tech. Familiarity with GAM, programmatic demand, or video ads is a big plus.
  • AdTech knowledge (GAM, programmatic, SSPs)
  • Experience with MCPs, AI agents, or Claude Code/Cowork


**The pay range for this position in New York is $80,000 – $120,000

details.name: Description
details.value:
Your Story:

You’ll be joining a core team at EX.CO to lead the charge with our customers and get to work closely with all stakeholders at the company. This position is based in our NYC office. Acting as the liaison between your publishers and EX.CO’s Product, RevOps, and Tech teams to meet publisher KPIs, revenue goals, and evangelize EX.CO’s video platform. Delivering best-in-class services to your publishers by bringing them strategic vision, training and planning sessions, and ensuring continuous growth through the different customer journey stages. You will be the face of EX.CO for your publishers and their biggest advocates to Product & Revenue teams. Keeping up with industry trends and updates to effectively educate and smoothly navigate your customers through the changes.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead strategic relationships with a portfolio of global Online Video and Connected TV (CTV) publisher accounts, building trusted executive relationships and guiding customers through every stage of the customer lifecycle to maximize retention, growth, and long-term success.
  • Manage a global book of business across multiple regions and time zones, ensuring proactive communication, timely execution, and a consistent, high-quality customer experience.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Business Development, Ad Operations, Product, Engineering, and other key stakeholders to deliver seamless customer onboarding, accelerate product adoption, and drive ongoing business growth.
  • Identify expansion and upsell opportunities by leveraging customer performance data, market trends, and new product capabilities to increase account value and support revenue growth.
  • Lead strategic business planning sessions, define customer success objectives, and deliver executive-level Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that communicate business outcomes, performance insights, and growth opportunities.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by advocating for publisher priorities internally, influencing product enhancements, and providing executive leadership with regular updates on customer health, risks, opportunities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrate deep technical and industry expertise by leveraging self-service platforms, navigating complex advertising technology ecosystems, and applying programmatic advertising knowledge to resolve customer challenges and optimize business outcomes.

  • Previously worked as a Program or Project Manager directly with customers.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Your Story:

We’re looking for a hands-on, tech-savvy Team Lead to manage our Implementation Support Team. You’ll lead a team of Technical Support Engineers who support EX.CO customers and work closely with other EX.CO operations teams (Customer Success, Technical Customer Success and Demand relationships). The team handles operational, data-driven, and configuration-based tasks. Your goal is to make sure our clients get excellent service by building smart processes, setting the bar for quality, and making sure technical work is done right.


﻿Our Story:

At the heart of every digital revolution, there’s a story. Ours began in 2012, with a vision of creating a publisher video platform that offers all the necessary tools, innovation, and knowledge publishers need to fully optimize their websites with video.

Through machine-learning and AI technology, EX.CO empowers publishers to own their video content and monetization strategies to maximize revenue. Our platform offers global publishers unparalleled access to best-in-class ad serving, monetization, content automation, and video recommendation.

Trusted by some of the leading publishers globally including The Arena Group, CBSi, Hearst, Nasdaq, VICE, and more, EX.CO’s platform helps publishers boost audience engagement and increase revenue. Our success is a direct result of our dedicated team located around the world and visionary backers including The Walt Disney Company, Saban Ventures, Viola Group, 83North, and Firstime Ventures.

At EX.CO’s core is a passion for reimagining the video space and an unyielding commitment to those who rely on us. And now, we’re looking for remarkable talent like you to join the next chapter of our story. 🌟


﻿What You’ll Do:

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Technical Support Engineers, including hiring, onboarding, goal setting and performance reviews.
  • Own the team’s workload and priorities, making sure tasks are handled on time and with high quality.
  • Oversee new client onboarding and day-to-day operations so launches go smoothly and clients keep succeeding.
  • Be the go-to person for complex escalations. Jump in hands-on to troubleshoot and debug production issues.
  • Creating and running automated workflows and developer tools using AI.
  • leveraging AI agents and intelligent bots for workflow automation.
  • Oversee platform configurations, including content setup, video player settings and ad integrations, plus QA after launch.
  • Make sure system performance is monitored across platforms and anomalies are flagged and handled fast.
  • Build and improve team processes, SOPs and knowledge base. Find ways to automate and work smarter.
  • Work closely with Dev, AdOps, Product and CS to escalate issues, share customer feedback and align on priorities.
  • Own reporting and internal dashboards (KPIs, SLAs, ticket trends) to keep cross-functional teams aligned.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
﻿What We’re Looking For:

  • 2-3+ years of experience managing a team of Technical Support Engineers (or a similar tech support / implementation team).
  • Strong technical background: hands-on JavaScript with real debugging ability (DevTools), plus solid CSS and HTML.
  • Expertise in creating and running automated workflows and developer tools using AI.
  • Experience in leveraging AI agents and intelligent bots for workflow automation.
  • Experience with logging/monitoring tools (Datadog, Groundcover, Logz.io or similar): searching logs, tracing issues and finding errors.
  • Strong production and troubleshooting mindset. Comfortable in production environments and reading API responses (JSON and XML).
  • Experience with Git and basic Git workflows.
  • Proven ability to build processes, manage priorities and drive high-quality execution.
  • Experience working with Dev / AdOps / Engineering teams.
  • Excellent English and clear communication. Strong ownership and comfortable working across time zones.


Advantage: Ad-tech or video background, experience working with American or multicultural teams, technical degree, or QA automation.

The role is full-time, hybrid (3 office days), from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Eastern European Time.

details.value:
About EX.CO

EX.CO is the video technology fueling growth for media leaders worldwide. Since we launched, our mission has been to shape the future of media technology, powering media owners’ business success in a rapidly changing reality across web, mobile, CTV and DOOH. Today, we partner with leading companies, including USA Today, People Inc., Hearst Newspapers, Motorsport Network, and Ziff Davis (Mashable). Our machine learning engine uses billions of predictions to grow video ad revenue, giving media owners the control, scale, and transparency they need to thrive.

What drives us is simple: we’re stronger together, always evolving, and radically transparent. Collaboration fuels our best work, innovation keeps us ahead, and honesty builds lasting trust with our colleagues, partners, and customers. We are proudly backed by The Walt Disney Company, Saban Ventures, Viola Group, 83North, and others.

Now we’re growing our team—and that’s where you come in. We’re building a place where talented people make an impact, ideas spark change, and everyone has a seat at the table.

﻿

﻿The Role

﻿We're looking for a VP Marketing to lead EX.CO's brand, creative and market presence. You'll own marketing strategy and execution across brand identity, content and video, social channels, PR and communications, events and growth.

You'll work hand in hand with our Go To Market and Business teams, helping crystallize our messaging, refine our visual language, take our identity into new areas of the media world, and drive new business opportunities. You'll also partner closely with Product and the executive team, and stay hands-on.


﻿What You and Your Team Will Do

  • Build and own the marketing strategy across our different offerings and audiences, create annual and quarterly plans according to budget
  • Lead our fierce and excellent marketing team and external consultants 
  • Help refine our brand identity, messaging and visual guidelines across all touchpoints
  • Drive growth campaigns and demand generation tied to pipeline - including media buying strategy, campaigns and creatives
  • Own our external facing communications and channels, PR & media relations strategy 
  • Lead content and video production, including thought leadership
  • Plan and run EX.CO's presence at key industry events
  • Support our internal communications efforts

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in B2B tech marketing, 4+ in senior leadership. AdTech or media experience is a strong plus
  • A track record of leading campaigns, growth and content at a senior level
  • Strong in both brand and performance, with a clear link to revenue
  • A good visual eye and experience managing creative and PR external resources
  • A collaborative style and experience working alongside GTM, Sales and Product leaders
  • Native-level English
  • Strategic and hands-on
